item.title: Stop using chat interfaces for your command line interfaces!
item.description: I believe people are using MCP services incorrectly and using AI incorrectly when integrating with their cybersecurity tools, or perhaps tools in general, but specifically cybersecurity tools. Instead of creating a new interface to control your tools, meaning instead of using the normal command line, people now use MCP servers and e.g. Claude to issue commands. So they go to Claude/ChatGPT/X, write in natural language what they want to achieve, and Claude maps the intent to the correct tool and executes it, perhaps with some analysis, formatting, or summarization of the results.
